text:
deploy-bot: Starting phased rollout v3.2.1 -> US (gradual 10% -> 50%), EU (holding), APAC (holding). Window 02:00-05:00 UTC. Release note: KV-cache hotfix + batching tweak.

maria.g: on it — kicking off capacity smoke in us-west now.

aj: canary passed in us-east (p95=180ms, err=0.2%) :thumbsup:

maria.g: capacity summary (us-west): GPUs free=86%, avg tokens/sec=1.2k, no OOMs in last 10m. quick logs attaching below.

deploy-bot: smoke logs:
```json
{"region":"us-west","p95":180,"err_rate":0.002,"tokens_per_sec":1200}
```

charlie: EU cluster (eu-central-1) is hot — remaining allocable capacity ~18%, p95 spikes up to 420ms on 8k prompt traces.

lina: suggest pinning EU to v3.1.9 and continue US ramp. avoid cross-region fallback during APAC peak.

ops-liz: +1 to pin EU. what command do we run to pin? deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: pin command:
```bash
deployctl pin-version --region eu --version v3.1.9 --reason "capacity-safety"
```

aj: I'll run EU pinned canary verification for 10m and watch p95 / error rate.

maria.g: APAC warm pool is warming (20%), leaving APAC at 0% traffic until EU stabilizes.

charlie: note: if EU p95 > 400ms OR eu err_rate > 1% we should consider rolling back US to v3.2.0 to reduce blast radius.

sre-bot: Alert rule added: (eu.p95 > 400ms) OR (eu.err_rate > 0.01) -> auto-fallback to v3.1.9. Notifying oncall @ops-liz.

ops-liz: ack, monitoring dashboards and will post status updates.

maria.g: release notes pushed to docs and changelog: https://internal/docs/releases/v3.2.1 — includes perf regression tests and KV-cache note.

deploy-bot: US ramp to 20% in 15m. will post another status update after EU canary window.

charlie: :thumbsup:
